Oliver — quick technical note from infra: when organizer is rewritten by a calendar proxy the Meet token that's embedded in the invite may not map to the actual meeting entry (token drift). Zoom invitations don't rely on that same token-mapping, so creating a short-lived Zoom link is the most robust workaround for mixed-SSO environments.

If Marissa generates the Zoom invite:
- I'll add a one-time join passcode and set registration to off.
- Monica, can you confirm whether we should add an email alias (partners@acme.com) as an alternate organizer in the invite or not? Sometimes adding the alias as an additional organizer prevents the proxy from stripping the organizer header.

Marissa — I can create the meeting in our Zoom account if you want me to author it and then you can forward it from your calendar; that keeps the scheduler footprint small.

Ben
